notes: Stories already complete and correctly decomposed; refined scope clarity and sizing for implementation realism.

change_log.note: Up-sized due to pagination, retries, parsing complexity, and external API variability

change_log.value: Implement ClinicalTrials.gov API integration with recruiting filter, condition/location query handling, structured parsing of trial data, eligibility summary normalization, trial site extraction, pagination handling with result limits, retry/backoff for rate limits, and defensive error handling for malformed or partial responses.
change_log.note: Clarified pagination limits and defensive handling

change_log.value: Add optional travel distance and duration enrichment using Google Routes API based on user location and trial sites, including batching of route requests, conditional execution when location is present, distance/time normalization, and graceful fallback when site or route data is incomplete or API fails.

Expose clinical trials search via EvaluateCare facade and tool router with validated inputs, strict schema enforcement, structured output formatting, and compatibility with Anthropic tool-use patterns per GOV-004, including safe handling of empty or partial result sets.
change_log.note: Added empty/partial result handling at API layer

change_log.value: Create unit and integration tests covering API fetch, parsing, eligibility normalization, pagination limits, travel enrichment, facade-level response validation, tool_router integration, and edge cases including empty results, malformed responses, timeouts, and external API failures using mocks.
change_log.note: Expanded coverage to include pagination limits explicitly
